steps.name: Enya
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Crowd of Elders
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm very sorry, but I've gathered you here today not for the study of scriptures, but for more mundane concerns.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A Kazimierz trade representative has requested a meeting with the Saintess of Karlan. May I have your thoughts?

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Preposterous! How can an outsider be allowed to meet the Saintess on a whim?

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Moreover, Karlan will not tolerate outsiders treading upon her land.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: True. If we welcomed secular matters into the Vine-Bead Court, I fear it would unnecessarily disturb the peace of all present.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But as Kjerag's administrator, declining their request would inevitably harm our diplomatic efforts.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: It was always Enciodes's role to discuss business with outsiders. This is the wish of a mere businessman. Moreover, wanting to chat with the Saintess is inappropriate in itself.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm afraid you're wrong. The General Chamber of Commerce's sway in Kazimierz cannot be belittled.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: On top of which, I'm worried they will leverage their developed economy and enormous capital to pressure us into submitting to unfavorable contract terms.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A GCC representative being sent to Kjerag signifies their desire to partner with us on multiple fronts.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: More importantly, this requested audience shows obvious intent far beyond the commercial.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A contract with Karlan Trade was only the beginning.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Enciodes is only leader of the Silverashes, after all. The weight of his promises and guarantees could never rival mine.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: If you should personally meet an outsider, Saintess... such action alone would be weighty enough.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: My view exactly.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: So you have resolved to bring an outsider into the Vine-Bead Court?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No. Karlan is still Karlan, and the Vine-Bead Court is sacred ground within Kjerag. I would not wish to displease Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Thus, I will descend the mountain to receive Kazimierz's representative.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Descending merely to bend to an outsider's rudeness—this is beyond improper.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Even our own devout citizens are hard-pressed to glimpse the Saintess. Why should this faithless outsider be allowed to meet her so casually?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hm. I agree that he should be made to realize what an honor such a meeting is, so I will require that he attend with the worshippers at the upcoming ceremonies to pay respects to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As for Kjerag's people... Perhaps they will not understand their Saintess' decision this time, but eventually they will come to accept this shift.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As our connection with the outside world grows more intimate by the day, I can only presume more such political figures will seek meetings here. And I must assume responsibility in kind.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Furthermore, I invite all Elders to weigh this matter too. No doubt you're all aware of the potential consequences of indulging Enciodes in his business.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In exchange for industrial technology, Karlan Trade has signed many an unfavorable contract for Kjerag, this much is certain.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I am not criticizing him; he was powerless to do anything else. However, my hope is that circumstances will gradually become more advantageous for us over time.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Surely Kjeragandr, who protects our people, would wish for this too.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Enciodes, Enciodes... If not for him, Kjerag wouldn't be so... *sigh*.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: Now, now. Most people don't spend their lives looking out over snowy mountains.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: We're all old fuddy-duddies by now. What's the harm in letting the youngsters live more comfortable lives?

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: However, Saintess, I'm afraid you have a difficult road ahead of you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's fine by me. Between the care of my maids and the protection of the Silverashes' soldiers, I have little to worry about.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And you have no need to fret over the ordeals of the conference table... Kjeragandr will bless Her people.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Whew—this place is freezing.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I can’t remember the last time I went somewhere I could see my breath.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Man, I just wanted to see some snow. If I knew this place was so freaking chilly, I wouldn't have applied for Kjerag fieldwork.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Eh, at least I'm just here to meet someone, and HR said I can call it off if they don't show up by 4 PM.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Applying for a post and then missing the appointment? Who does this guy think he is?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Might as well check the file... 'Pramanix'. Derived from 'first snow'. Chilly name, too. Those clothes look pretty snug though.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ah, whatever, I'll go ask if they sell any heat patches around here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hey, sir, do you stock any heat patches?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Yes, yes, coming—heat what now? I didn't quite catch that.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: You must be a tourist from afar. You want some nice warm tea, I'm guessing?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: It's pretty cold here, no? Some tourists say they could freeze to death, others say it's nothing special.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: I'll pour you some tea while you take a look around.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Uh, okay...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Whew, this place sure does have everything. Never seen any of it before either.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Here, get some tea in you for now. This is what keeps us going when we cross the snowfields here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh, sure. Thanks.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: So where are you from?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Um, Rhodes Island...?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Rings a bell... but I can't put a face to the name, as it were. Tourists are always coming and going, you know.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (The person in that portrait strikes me as kinda familiar though...)

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Who ever knew the outside world was so gosh darn huge? I've a mind to see it myself, once I save up enough cash.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (Let me take that photo out again.)

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: First time in Kjerag? Or repeat visitor? We do sell souvenirs...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sorry, but can I ask a weird question? Do a lot of people in Kjerag look like the one in this picture?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: What in the...? This is our Saintess, you know. We'd be in trouble if there were any lookalikes running around.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Times were, the Saintess only had a few portraits, each hung in front of a clan's home. Their subjects would go in person to pray to it.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: If I'm honest, no one ever knew whether the portraits looked anything like the Saintess. Commoners like us'd only get to see her once a year at most, at the Ceremony.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: And that's from across a sea of people in the square. One glimpse a mile away.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: The chance to hear the Saintess' bell, to receive Kjeragandr's blessings, that was enough for us.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: But times change. Tourists started coming in, and Sir Enciodes learned an awful lot of outsiders were curious about the Saintess, so he called on everyone to make all these portraits, embroideries, and statues.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Of course, he'd make sure the portraits were accurate too. After all, he gets to meet the Saintess herself all the time.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: I mean, she's his own little sister, so of course he knows her well, yeah?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ha, I never knew...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So, hypothetically speaking, what would happen if the Saintess left Kjerag?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Huh? How would she? She hardly ever even comes down from Karlan.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: And when she does, it's because something big's happened.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Hey, boy, you'd never believe me if I told you Kjerag is blessed by Kjeragandr, would you? None of you tourists do.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Er, I'd say I'm closer to agnostic...?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Now listen here. My business is only around thanks to Kjeragandr's miracles, brought about by the Saintess.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: I had barely opened my shop last year when they started fighting.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: 'They' being...?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: *Sigh* The three clans, wouldn't you know it. Strife and turmoil.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: They didn't just fight either, the worst part was when they blew up the railroad. No railroad, no tourists, no freight.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: I'd put all the savings I'd scraped together into this, and now my business was frozen over. What's a man to do?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: So I prayed day after day, begging Kjeragandr to show me a way.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: And sure as sure, my prayers came true. The Saintess descended, Kjeragandr created a miracle, and nobody dared try anything else.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Ah, by Kjeragandr...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So, just—I'm just curious here, what's the Saintess like in person? Is she, uh, easy to get along with?

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: Haha, listen to yourself.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: The Saintess is the recipient of Kjeragandr, so she'd have to be the forgiving sort.

steps.name: Shopkeep
steps.text: If I weren't so sure that Kjeragandr Herself is a forgiving god, how would I find it in me to even answer such an offensive question?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Haha, yeah, sorry about that...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Thanks, sir. I'll take one of your cloaks.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Er, just a normal one, please. It doesn't need the Saintess embroidered on it... Normal, thanks.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's been such a pleasure meeting with you, but I'm sorry, I'm afraid I must cut this short.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Saintess' daily meditation is soon, and I cannot neglect it.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: No, no, I'm the one who should be sorry for disturbing your routine. Please, do as you always do.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: To be honest, I wasn't actually expecting to get to meet the Karlan Saintess on this visit.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm more than happy to show myself, given Kazimierz's interest in mutually beneficial exchange with Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And I'd imagine that for the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce, successfully reaching Kjerag's Saintess is itself a form of provocation.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: Meaning...?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Before too long, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz will attempt to contact Kjerag as well.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: ...You're quite familiar with us.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: I assume you would welcome such a development then?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is but a necessary step in Kjerag's foreign outreach. If I had to say, I can only hope the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's representative will be as amicable and sincere regarding mutual benefit as you were.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Kazimierz Representative
steps.text: If future dealings between Kjerag and the KGCC will have the support of the Saintess, I see nothing but smooth sailing ahead.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: May Kjeragandr bless you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Oh dear, it's almost 4 PM already...

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: Thank you for making this journey, Saintess.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: An outsider was so bold as to seek audience with you, and not only did you forego criticism, you made an exception to meet him. You are truly generous.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: We at Karlan Trade are deeply ashamed that we could not settle the matter ourselves, forcing you be personally involved.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: We will strive to ensure no such offense to Kjeragandr occurs ever again.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Please, don't mind it. The Saintess is Kjeragandr's chosen envoy, after all; it's only right for me to be present for diplomatic affairs.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She is forgiving, and I descended the mountain in following Her decree.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: Yes... may we be grateful for Kjeragandr's blessing.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: The procession of burdenbeasts is ready outside. Our Silverash soldiers will see you back to the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That won't be necessary. I still have other arrangements, and I'd rather they not wait for me in the snow.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: I... worry that Sir Enciodes would reprimand us for our etiquette, in neglecting the Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Enciodes... Kjeragandr does not place blame, and nor should Her people.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Saintess' daily meditation awaits. Please, go on and return.

steps.name: Karlan Trade Manager
steps.text: Very well. My apologies.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: May Kjeragandr bless you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Phew... finally over. I need to hurry to where we agreed to meet...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Enciodes is so annoying, choosing this moment to mess up my plans.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hmph. If anyone else tries to stop me, forget the excuses, I'll just freeze them on the spot.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In any case, nobody would ever guess where I'm going, not even him. They just want to keep me shut away in the Vine-Bead Court again.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Indeed, it's time for the Saintess to do her homework.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But for now, I'm just Enya.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Oh, wait, no. For now, I'm Pramanix.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: '...I have other matters I must attend to on this descent, beyond meeting the Kazimierz representative.'

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: 'For the following half-month, I must regrettably ask that all affairs of the Vine-Bead Court be entrusted to the Elders.'

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Was this letter truly left by the Saintess herself?

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: We've seen her annotating the scriptures for so many years. I would think we can recognize her handwriting.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: It seems she's had this in mind for a while now.

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: This is an outrage, I tell you, an outrage!

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: If it were known that she has not merely descended, but went missing for half an entire month, what of the dignity the Vine-Bead Court? Of the Saintess herself?

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: Kjeragandr may yet bring Her fury upon us all.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: Now, now. The Saintess is the one who receives Kjeragandr's decree. Should she say that She permits it, then we can only trust in her.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: Until she returns, we must assert that the Saintess is meditating indoors and is not taking visitors.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: Oh, Enya, though. That child has always had her own opinions. Whatever she's descended to do, I'm sure she has her reasons.

steps.name: Kindly Elder
steps.text: When has she ever failed to win us over, after all?

steps.name: Solemn Elder
steps.text: *Sigh* Enough. I've more or less decided how we're going to handle visitors.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: 'Head in and take the second alley from the restaurant selling stew.' Should be here...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It'll be four o'clock in five minutes. Still don't see anyone, huh.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Lemme just check the photo again... Not that I'd mistake the Karlan Saintess for anyone else, though.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Man, I bet this alley's the kind you enter on foot and leave on a stretcher...
Don't turn around.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Waugh! I surrender, I'm just a tourist, I've got no money on me, I'm estranged from my family, you won't get anything out of killing me—
Shh, quiet. Who are you?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Er, I just said I'm just a tourist...
Company?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Rhodes Island, a pharmaceutical firm, principally treating Oripathy. Probably not a great market presence here...
You'd better not whip that knife out.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: If you stabbed the Saintess, the charges alone would crush you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Huge apologies, Saintess of Karlan! By Kjeragandr! I beg you not to visit Her wrath upon me!

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: No harm, no foul. As agreed, I'm here to lend my aid to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: I see you even learned the words of praise we always use in Kjerag?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Phew. You scared the living daylights out of me. I just said whatever holy words came to mind...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: And now I'm even more scared that I nearly pulled a knife on you.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: No, but see, if even you recognize me as the Saintess, obviously anyone from Kjerag would too, right?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: So if this man all wrapped up in black wasn't from Rhodes Island, but just some other weirdo, and they saw me, then...

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Wouldn't there be rumors about the Saintess running around on her own?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: So I had to approach from behind, and confirm your identity first.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: This is NOT what I expected from the Saintess everyone's always talking about...

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Hm? But I'm Pramanix, not the Saintess. It's normal that we're nothing alike, right?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: And just so you know, if you ever call me 'Saintess' aboard Rhodes Island, I'll freeze your mouth shut.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Haha, okay...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Well, it just hit four. If you were any later, I might've already left.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Oh, but I've got a whole pile of people that still want me here. Who knows what trouble awaits us on the way back?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Right, I heard the Saintess doesn't get to descend whenever she wants.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Mhm, but if an ambassador comes calling, what choice does she have?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: That's why before Kjarr went to Rhodes Island, I asked her to make a quick detour to speak to a Kazimierz rep visiting Kjerag.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Through her, I made a little suggestion.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: And so, a few days later, news of his request to meet the Saintess was reported to the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You worked with him to get down the mountain?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: But not just for fun, of course.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Without this opportunity, outsiders wouldn't even know Kjerag had a Saintess, let alone that she was so willing to meet them. They'd think we were only Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Heh. If Enciodes had his way, then that just might...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait, I thought Enciodes was your—

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: —Come to think it, I've never left Kjerag before.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (Whoops. Guess that's a touchy subject.)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yeah, I'd never left Victoria before I boarded Rhodes Island either.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Good thing we've got chefs from all over Terra. You'll never go hungry, at least.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But still, it's hard not to get homesick. Regional specialties just aren't the same as your family's home cooking.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Have you ever been back, then?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Uh, where'd that come from...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm Infected, so I wouldn't be welcome there anyway. Can't go home even if I wanted to.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: I was just a little curious, since the most I met were people who came home from abroad.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: One spent years outside of Kjerag, and by the time he came back, I didn't recognize him one bit.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There's the kicker. I'm guessing he was young, and then got all grown up in the blink of an eye, right?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Exactly. But he didn't just get taller, his shoulders got broader too... and his way of thinking was completely different.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Hardly anyone used to leave Kjerag, so I always wondered what it was like out there. Just what it was he saw, you know?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: And if every person who left would be changed just as much.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Let's get a move on. I'm dying to get to Rhodes Island and see Kjarr again.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sure, let's go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh yeah, when someone told me you were the Saintess, I picked up this cloak for you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Put up the hood and it'll cover your face. That'll keep anyone from noticing you at a glance.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Wow, you're very thoughtful.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Could you hold my book for a moment? I'll put it on now.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sure—'A Brief History of the Battle of the Four Emperors'?

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Oh, the Doctor lent me that book.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: My room is still piled up with what the Doctor gave me for light reading. I'm planning to return this one once I'm done, and we can talk about the rest another time.

steps.name: Pramanix
steps.text: Speaking of which, I suppose I've never actually met the Doctor... I hope they won't make me do any work. This is supposed to be a vacation, after all.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Operators are supposed to work at Rhodes Island though...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ah, whatever. Here's to a pleasant holiday for you.
